pet_notes: Preserve the exact approved middle fox identity: cream fur, blue-purple ear tips, large blue-lavender tail, blue collar with round cyan pendant, cute compact full-body proportions. This is an animation test for a 30-point-high MacBook Touch Bar.
style_notes: Polished soft 3D chibi mascot matching the approved references exactly; transparent-ready clean silhouette; details must remain readable at 24 to 28 pixels tall.
style_contract: Pet-safe sprite: compact full-body mascot, readable in a 192x208 cell, clear silhouette, simple face, stable palette/materials, and crisp edges for chroma-key extraction. Style `3d-toy`: Stylized 3D toy mascot with smooth rounded forms, simple materials, clear silhouette, and no photoreal complexity.
